description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 008 are a scallop pattern terracotta jali with overlapping curved arches, as the product photo shows, for feature walls and screens that need a softer look than a straight grid.

## How it looks
The photo shows rows of overlapping arches that create a scalloped, almost fish-scale rhythm. Curves soften a wall and tend to suit both traditional homes and Mediterranean-style or modern houses. In natural terracotta, the arches catch light along their edges and throw curved shadows behind.

## Where it works
- **Arch pattern jali** on a veranda, porch or entrance wall.
- **Curved clay jali design** as a garden or rooftop screen where straight lines feel too hard.
- **Fish scale jali wall** behind a seating area, a water feature or planting.

Curved patterns usually look best on a wall you see face-on, so plan it where people approach or sit.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: overlapping curved arch / scallop (from the product photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you set out the wall.

Start the first course perfectly level, because a curved pattern makes any slope easy to spot. Keep mortar off the visible face and clean with water and a soft brush.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall size for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide), see [outdoor and front wall tile ideas](/blog/outdoor-wall-tiles-and-front-wall-tiles-for-house-exteriors), or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of scallop pattern terracotta jali?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Where does a scallop or arch jali pattern work best?
faqs.a: On walls you see face-on, such as an entrance, a veranda or a screen behind seating. The curves soften the wall and suit both traditional and modern houses.

faqs.q: Scallop jali or square grid jali: which is easier to install?
faqs.a: A square grid is more forgiving. A curved pattern needs a level first course and careful alignment, so give your mason time to dry-lay a few rows first.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 008" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
